text: Qatar Foundation was created by Sheikh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani, the late Father Amir of Qatar, and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser; Sheikha Moza is Chairperson of Qatar Foundation.
short: Qatar Foundation was created by the late Father Amir and Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, its chairperson

source.name: Qatar Foundation: About — Our Leadership
source.note: QF's own account page, 'Our Leadership' section. The page names no state ownership or stake; the foundation's creation is attributed to the two founders.
source.quote: His Highness Sheikh Hamad Bin Khalifa Al Thani, the late Father Amir of Qatar, and Her Highness Sheikha Moza bint Nasser shared a vision for Qatar's future development, which led to the creation of Qatar Foundation.

additionalSources.name: Qatar Foundation: Qatar Foundation announces new CEO
additionalSources.note: QF's own announcement naming Sheikha Moza bint Nasser as Chairperson of Qatar Foundation (photo caption on the page).
additionalSources.quote: Her Highness Sheikha Moza bint Nasser, Chairperson of Qatar Foundation, with Her Excellency Sheikha Hind bint Hamad Al Thani and Yousif Al-Naama.
